entities.summary: Augustine Cuero Rubit is an American professional basketball player for Unicaja of the Liga ACB and BCL. He is a 2.03 m tall power forward-center. He played college basketball at the University of South Alabama. Rubit was an All-American player at South Alabama, and was one of the nation's best rebounders.
